expectedIssues: Green Bowl Poké card appears twice in the carousel
reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same 15–25 min ETA and €0.90 delivery fee, suggesting duplicated data or a rendering key bug.

The third carousel item ('Smash Bros Bu…') is hard-clipped at the screen edge, and its title and price text are truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making the item look broken rather than scrollable.
The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is abruptly cut off by the bottom tab bar; its name, rating and metadata row are not visible, so the list appears to end mid-card.
Favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
The notification bell with a red badge and the heart favourite buttons are icon-only controls with no visible text label, so their purpose and state may not be conveyed to screen readers.
Placeholder-looking flat illustrations are used as restaurant imagery in the carousel, and the same illustration repeats, which reads as unloaded/mock content.

expected.reasoning: Issue 0 directly describes the Green Bowl Poké card appearing twice in the carousel with identical details.
